title: A new Part Library entry appears only when a new part number is used
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and opens Settings → Data Import.
  • Part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NEWENTRY-01) is in no Part Library entry yet.
  • Part number {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NEWENTRY-02) is in no Part Library entry yet.
  • Import file {Import-file-A} holds one row for {Part-B} (for example description "ZZAUTOTEST PL imported entry", a category, cost 10.00, quantity 2).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click New Inventory Part.
  3. Type a Description (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL new entry").
  4. Type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Pick any Category.
  6. Type 10.00 in Cost.
  7. Type 20.00 in Sell Price.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  10. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  11. Click the {Part-A} row.
  12. Open Settings → Data Import → Inventory and import {Import-file-A}.
  13. Open Parts → Part Library.
  14. Type {Part-B} in the Search box.
  15. Look through the Part Library page and its menus for any way to create an entry without a part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: The part is saved with no message about the Part Library (a new entry was created, not linked).
  • Step 10: One entry {Part-A} is listed, with the description you typed.
  • Step 11: Its detail page shows "Total parts" 1: the new inventory part is behind it.
  • Step 14: One entry {Part-B} is listed: the parts CSV import created it from the imported row.
  • Step 15: There is no way on screen to create an entry with no part, part request, delivery receipt, core charge, return or import row behind it.
  • Step 15: Ways behind the screen, including the separate public API create (which this release does not change), cannot be checked by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R6, S11-N1, S11-E3, S7-R7, S7-R10, §4 Key Decisions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”
  • S7-R7: “If no entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry with the typed number and description, and links the part to it.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
  • S11-N1: “No route, on screen or behind it, produces a Part Library entry with no inventory part, part request, delivery receipt, core charge, return or import row behind it. The one exception is the public API (S11-E3).”
  • S11-E3: “The public API create is a separate integration and is not changed by S11-R1.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (The Part Library has no standalone create): “The Part Library has no standalone create. Every Part Library entry is created from a part number in use.”
